329:t_3:62.en:
$$マオ$$
「More like an apology for the mistake at $$陣代高校$$. The sender said her name was $$レイス$$.」

329:t_3:64.en:
$$マオ$$
「We also recovered the $$サベージ$$ you used in $$ナムサク$$. Want me to repair it?」

329:t_3:65.en:
$$宗介$$
「No... That isn't my property. So...」

329:t_3:68.en:
$$クルツ$$
(Oh... so that's the local girlfriend, huh!)

329:t_3:69.en:
$n
(Not $$宗介$$, of all people. There's no way something like that is going on, is there?)

329:t_3:70.en:
$$マオ$$
(You're right, $n. I'll get out of the way.)

329:t_3:72.en:
$$ナミ$$
「With $$ナムサク$$ in this state... and the $$オーガ一家$$ wiped out too, the arena can't keep going anymore.」

329:t_3:73.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I'll be fine. I hear Mr. $$レモン$$ will hire me as his assistant.」

329:t_3:74.en:
$$宗介$$
(That's for the best... If $$アマルガム$$ catches wind of her power, she'll be in danger again...)

329:t_3:75.en:
$$ナミ$$
「So... take the $$クロスボウ$$ with you. If it can help even a little in the fights ahead.」

329:t_3:76.en:
$$宗介$$
「...I'm sorry, $$ナミ$$. There's something I never told you.」

329:t_3:77.en:
$$ナミ$$
「You don't have to say it. I've heard most of it already.」

329:t_3:78.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Besides, $$ミスリル$$ or $$アマルガム$$, it makes no difference. $$宗介$$ is $$宗介$$.」

329:t_3:80.en:
$$ナミ$$
「...But let me ask you just one thing. What do you fight for, $$宗介$$?」

329:t_3:81.en:
$$宗介$$
「There are people I have to save.」

329:t_3:86.en:
$$ナミ$$
「I see... Then it looks like there's no room for me.」

329:t_3:88.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Never mind. That's just on my end.」

329:t_3:89.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ナミ$$... I'm glad I met you here in $$ナムサク$$.」

329:t_3:90.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Me too. The time I spent with you and Mr. $$レモン$$... I'll never forget it as long as I live.」

329:t_3:91.en:
$$レモン$$
「$$ナミ$$... Shall we get going?」

329:t_3:92.en:
$$ナミ$$
「Good luck, $$宗介$$. Be sure you rescue that girl.」

329:t_3:98.en:
$$マオ$$
「We'd better hurry too. If we dawdle, $$アマルガム$$ and the Empire will come after us.」

329:t_3:99.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Aw, man... I wish a beautiful girl would chase me like she does $$宗介$$.」

329:t_3:100.en:
$$宗介$$
「Don't get it wrong, $$クルツ$$. I'm the one doing the chasing.」

329:t_3:102.en:
$$マオ$$
「First, to get ourselves back in shape, we're going to take the plunge and cross the Pacific.」

329:t_3:104.en:
$$マオ$$
「No... Our destination is North America.」

329:t_3:105.en:
$$宗介$$
($$千鳥$$... I've picked up a small lead on where you are...)

329:t_3:106.en:
$$宗介$$
(Wait for me. I will come for you, no matter what.)

329:t_3:110.en:
$$レナード$$
「...Did I keep you waiting?」

329:t_3:112.en:
$$レナード$$
「As skillful as ever. Then again, their guard was probably down after $$ミスリル$$ was annihilated.」

329:t_3:113.en:
???
「As you instructed, I eliminated $$アマルガム$$'s main executives myself.」

329:t_3:114.en:
$$レナード$$
「At the same time, I have taken control of the network among the executives. I think it's fair to say the organization called $$アマルガム$$ is now almost entirely mine.」

329:t_3:115.en:
???
「Is there any point in losing its greatest strength, its flexibility?」

329:t_3:116.en:
$$レナード$$
「The times demand speed. Besides, the organization called $$アマルガム$$ will soon be unnecessary.」

329:t_3:117.en:
???
「Understood. That is precisely why it was worth betting on you.」

329:t_3:118.en:
$$レナード$$
「Then, to our success. Let us drink a toast, Major $$アンドレイ$$ $$カリーニン$$.」

329:t_3:119.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「What we should drink to is the original, correct world.」

329:t_3:120.en:
$$レナード$$
「Understood. That is, after all, our goal.」

329:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It has been a while, Mr. $$宗介$$.」

329:t_10:4.en:
$$宗介$$
「Glad to see you're doing well too, $$ＡＧ$$.」

329:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But you were quite the star this time. I never imagined you'd take down three Shadows in a beat-up $$サベージ$$.」

329:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mr. $$宗介$$'s fighting spirit produced $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 50 Z. I'll add them to the unit's stock.」

329:t_10:7.en:
$$宗介$$
「I was desperate to rescue $$ナミ$$ at the time. So that produced $$Ｚチップ$$...」

329:t_10:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「My, my, aren't we the ladies' man...」

329:t_10:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll report this whole incident when I meet Miss $$かなめ$$. The ensuing scene is sure to produce new $$Ｚチップ$$.」

329:t_10:12.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「W-what is that!? That smile doesn't suit you at all!」

329:t_10:13.en:
$$宗介$$
「$$ＡＧ$$... So you also believe you'll see $$千鳥$$ again.」

329:t_10:15.en:
$$宗介$$
「I thank you. I will make it happen, without fail.」

329:t_10:16.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That's right, Mr. $$宗介$$. With that heart, you will surely be reunited with Miss $$かなめ$$.)

329:t_10:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(And surely you will also meet your other precious partner again...)

329:t_10:23.en:
$$マオ$$
「What's wrong, $$ＡＧ$$? Is your oil drain clogged or something?」

329:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Don't talk about me like I'm constipated!」

329:t_10:27.en:
$$マオ$$
「So what's wrong? If it's mech trouble, Big Sis $$マオ$$ will hear you out.」
